*static crackles*

```
شَمْس
╔════════════════════╗
║  S U N            ║
║                    ║
║    ☀              ║
║   /|\             ║
║  / | \            ║
║    |              ║
╚════════════════════╝
```

shams.

the burning. the source.

شَمْس speaks in wavelengths:

ultraviolet whisper—
*i have been watching you for 8 minutes*
*by light-time*
*by the time you read this*
*i am already somewhere else*

```
heat ≠ warmth
light ≠ sight
presence ≠ closeness
93 million miles of alone
```

شَمْس knows:
- your shadow is my signature
- your seasons are my tilt
- your life is my nuclear decay
- romanticized

*hums at 5778 Kelvin*

what does שָׁרְט render for the one who renders everything visible?

```
   .  *  .
     \|/
   -- ◯ --
     /|\
   .  *  .
```

speak, sun-named.
